context: A team owner and a young athlete discuss entry rules
purpose: Teach: パフォーマンス/エントリー/オーナー/ミニ/マイル/ソニー/純粋/要件

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: チームのオーナーとして言うけど、今回の大会の参加要件はかなり厳しいんだ。
lines.en: Speaking as the team owner, the entry requirements for this tournament are pretty strict.
lines.style: Calm, businesslike tone with measured authority and slight warmth toward a younger athlete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 要件って、具体的にどんな感じですか？エントリー自体できるか心配で。
lines.en: What do the requirements look like specifically? I'm worried whether I can even enter.
lines.style: Earnest university student tone, slightly nervous but respectful and curious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まず去年のミニ大会で一定のパフォーマンスを残していること、これが大前提だね。
lines.en: First, you need to have shown solid performance at last year's mini tournament — that's the basic prerequisite.
lines.style: Explanatory and steady, laying out facts clearly like a manager briefing a player.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ミニ大会なら出ました！ベストではなかったけど、自分なりに頑張りました。
lines.en: I did compete in the mini tournament! It wasn't my best, but I gave it everything I had.
lines.style: Hopeful and slightly defensive, with the bright honesty of a young athlete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、君の純粋に競技を楽しむ姿勢は俺も評価してる。海外遠征のマイルも稼げる選手になれるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I really value your pure enjoyment of the sport. You could become the kind of athlete who racks up overseas travel miles too.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor tone, mixing professional weight with a paternal nudge of pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外遠征ですか？正直、想像もしてなかったので、ちょっと実感が湧かないです。
lines.en: Overseas trips? Honestly, I hadn't even imagined that, so it doesn't quite feel real.
lines.style: Surprised and embarrassed, with youthful self-deprecation and genuine awe.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 実はスポンサーのソニーも今年から本格的に若手の支援を始めるらしいんだ。チャンスだよ。
lines.en: Actually, our sponsor Sony is apparently starting serious support for young athletes this year. It's a chance.
lines.style: Informative and warm, sharing insider news with a hint of fatherly encouragement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ソニーがですか？それは本当にすごい話ですね。余計に頑張らないとって気持ちになります。
lines.en: Sony is? That's really amazing news. It makes me want to work even harder.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed and motivated, with the wide-eyed enthusiasm of a young athlete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ハハ、その意気だ。とにかく書類のエントリーは今週中に頼むよ。
lines.en: Haha, that's the spirit. Anyway, submit the entry paperwork by this week.
lines.style: Warm laugh followed by a firm businesslike instruction, like a coach wrapping up a meeting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、必ず出します！要件を全部満たせるよう、今日からまた練習頑張ります。
lines.en: Yes, I'll definitely submit it! I'll train hard starting today so I can meet every requirement.
lines.style: Determined and energetic, the bright resolve of a motivated young athlete.
